decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Within 1 month of the date of the permission (unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority) samples and plans of materials to be used to screen the external duct must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development must be carried out within 3 months (unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority) of the details being approved.

Condition : 3 - The use of the duct must not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority within 1 month of the date of the permission (unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority) and the works must be carried out within 3 months (unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Installation of external duct to existing premises
